full_name: Fernanda Viégas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Engineering & Computer Science Sally Starling Seaver Professor Harvard University
bio: Fernanda Viégas is a Sally Starling Seaver Professor at Harvard Radcliffe Institute and a Gordon McKay Professor of Computer Science at the Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences whose recent work in machine learning focuses on improving human/AI interaction with a broader agenda of raising AI literacy.
